registrar.name: Olivia Hale, Registrar of Voters, San Joaquin County
registrar.address: 44 North San Joaquin Street, Third Floor, Suite 350, Stockton, CA 95202 (mail: PO Box 810, Stockton, CA 95201)
registrar.email: registrar@sjgov.org (ROV home and Contact Us pages); the County VIG also lists registration@sjgov.org (general) and vbm@sjgov.org (vote-by-mail)
registrar.vca_src: Inferred, not stated outright by the ROV: the County VIG (p. 4, 7) and Notice of Election describe assigned polling places (159 sites; Election Day polls 7 a.m.-8 p.m.) with "No Wrong Location" countywide voting at any polling place, and early voting only at the ROV office; San Joaquin is not on the SOS Voter's Choice Act county list (https://www.sos.ca.gov/california-voters-choice-act/vca-counties; 27 counties listed, page may lag newer adopters).

dates.label: Logic & accuracy test begins
dates.detail: State-mandated L&A test of the voting system begins 11:00 a.m. at the ROV office, 44 N. San Joaquin St., Suite 350; open to public observation.
dates.label_es: Comienza la prueba de lógica y precisión
dates.detail_es: La prueba de lógica y precisión (L&A) del sistema de votación, exigida por el estado, comienza a las 11:00 a.m. en la oficina del Registro de Votantes (ROV), 44 N. San Joaquin St., Suite 350; abierta a la observación del público.

dates.label: County Voter Information Guides begin mailing
dates.detail: ROV begins mailing the County Voter Information Guide (E-40).
dates.label_es: Comienza el envío por correo de las Guías de Información para el Votante del condado
dates.detail_es: El Registro de Votantes (ROV) comienza a enviar por correo la Guía de Información para el Votante del condado (E-40).

dates.label: Vote-by-mail ballots mailed (no later than)
dates.detail: Ballots mailed to all registered voters no later than Oct 5, 2026 (E-29). Military/overseas ballots go out earlier (E-60 to E-45, Sept 4-19).
dates.label_es: Boletas por correo enviadas (a más tardar)
dates.detail_es: Boletas enviadas por correo a todos los votantes registrados a más tardar el 5 de oct. de 2026 (E-29). Las boletas militares y del extranjero se envían antes (E-60 a E-45, del 4 al 19 de sept.).

dates.label: Early in-person voting begins at the ROV office
dates.detail: Oct 5 through Nov 2, 2026 at 44 N. San Joaquin St., Suite 350, Stockton: Mon-Fri 8:00 a.m.-5:00 p.m., plus Saturday Oct 31, 8:00 a.m.-5:00 p.m.
dates.label_es: Comienza la votación anticipada en persona en la oficina del Registro de Votantes
dates.detail_es: Del 5 de oct. al 2 de nov. de 2026 en 44 N. San Joaquin St., Suite 350, Stockton: de lunes a viernes 8:00 a.m.-5:00 p.m., y además el sábado 31 de oct., 8:00 a.m.-5:00 p.m.

dates.label: Official ballot drop boxes available
dates.detail: 27 official drop boxes, Oct 5 through Nov 3, 8:00 p.m. per the County VIG and ROV calendar; NOTE the ROV drop-box web page says "starting October 2, 2026". Many boxes are 24 hours; others have limited hours. On Election Day all boxes are open 7 a.m.-8 p.m. and are locked at 8 p.m.
dates.detail_es: 27 buzones oficiales, del 5 de oct. al 3 de nov., 8:00 p.m., según la Guía de Información para el Votante del condado y el calendario del Registro de Votantes (ROV); NOTA: la página web de buzones del ROV dice "a partir del 2 de octubre de 2026". Muchos buzones están abiertos las 24 horas; otros tienen horario limitado. El Día de la Elección todos los buzones están abiertos de 7 a.m. a 8 p.m. y se cierran con llave a las 8 p.m.

dates.label: Last day to register to vote (15 days before)
dates.detail: Postmarks, DMV submissions and ROV delivery/drop-off acceptable. Online at registertovote.ca.gov.
dates.label_es: Último día para registrarse para votar (15 días antes)
dates.detail_es: Se aceptan sellos postales, envíos a través del DMV y entrega o depósito en el Registro de Votantes (ROV). En línea en registertovote.ca.gov.

dates.label: Conditional (same-day) voter registration window opens
dates.detail: Oct 20 through Nov 3, 2026: eligible voters who missed the deadline can register conditionally at the ROV office or at a polling place on Election Day; ballot counted after registration is verified.
dates.label_es: Se abre el período de registro condicional de votantes (el mismo día)
dates.detail_es: Del 20 de oct. al 3 de nov. de 2026: los votantes elegibles que no cumplieron el plazo pueden registrarse condicionalmente en la oficina del Registro de Votantes (ROV) o en un lugar de votación el Día de la Elección; su boleta se cuenta después de verificar el registro.

dates.label: Last day to file as a write-in candidate
dates.detail: Write-in candidacy papers due; SOS certifies list of nonpartisan write-in candidates Oct 23.
dates.label_es: Último día para presentarse como candidato por escrito (write-in)
dates.detail_es: Vencen los documentos de candidatura por escrito; la Secretaría de Estado (SOS) certifica la lista de candidatos por escrito no partidistas el 23 de oct.

dates.label: Last day to request a vote-by-mail ballot (E-7)
dates.detail: Replacement ballots available at the ROV office; Replacement Ballot Application on the ROV Current Election page.
dates.label_es: Último día para solicitar una boleta por correo (E-7)
dates.detail_es: Boletas de reemplazo disponibles en la oficina del Registro de Votantes (ROV); la Solicitud de Boleta de Reemplazo está en la página Current Election del ROV.

dates.label: Election Day - polls open 7:00 a.m. to 8:00 p.m.
dates.detail: Any polling place accepts voted VBM ballots; Drive-Up Democracy drop-off at the County Administration Building 7 a.m.-8 p.m. First results after 8:00 p.m.
dates.label_es: Día de la Elección - los lugares de votación abren de 7:00 a.m. a 8:00 p.m.
dates.detail_es: Cualquier lugar de votación acepta boletas por correo ya votadas; entrega "Drive-Up Democracy" en el Edificio de Administración del Condado (County Administration Building) de 7 a.m. a 8 p.m. Los primeros resultados después de las 8:00 p.m.

dates.label: Last day for ROV to receive mailed ballots (E+7)
dates.detail: Mail ballots must be postmarked on or before Nov 3 and received by 7 days after the election. Ballots returned in person (ROV office, drop box, polling place) must arrive by 8:00 p.m. on Election Day.
dates.label_es: Último día para que el Registro de Votantes reciba boletas enviadas por correo (E+7)
dates.detail_es: Las boletas por correo deben tener sello postal del 3 de nov. o antes y ser recibidas a más tardar 7 días después de la elección. Las boletas entregadas en persona (oficina del Registro de Votantes, buzón oficial, lugar de votación) deben llegar a más tardar a las 8:00 p.m. del Día de la Elección.

dates.label: Official canvass begins
dates.detail: 8:00 a.m. at ROV; ballot cure period begins (voters notified of signature problems; cure statement due by 5 p.m. two days before certification).
dates.detail_es: 8:00 a.m. en el Registro de Votantes (ROV); comienza el período para subsanar boletas (se notifica a los votantes sobre problemas con la firma; la declaración de subsanación debe presentarse a más tardar a las 5 p.m., dos días antes de la certificación).

dates.label: Certification deadline
dates.detail: ROV must certify results by Dec 3, 2026 (E+30); results posted at www.sjcrov.org.
dates.detail_es: El Registro de Votantes (ROV) debe certificar los resultados a más tardar el 3 de dic. de 2026 (E+30); los resultados se publican en www.sjcrov.org.

measures.title: Lodi Unified School District - School Improvement Bond of 2026
measures.question: With no estimated increase in current tax rates, shall Lodi Unified School District's measure to repair leaky roofs, plumbing, deteriorating electrical, gas lines, heating, and air conditioning; improve school security; and upgrade career training and college preparation classrooms be adopted, authorizing $195 million of bonds with legal rates, average annual levies below $22 per $100,000 of assessed valuation ($11.4 million annually) while outstanding, annual audits, independent citizen oversight, full disclosure of all spending, and all funds locally controlled?
measures.notes: VIG pdf pp. 578-582 (full text, tax rate statement, impartial analysis by County Counsel, argument in favor). Ballot response labels are "BONDS YES" / "BONDS NO".

measures.title: Escalon Unified School District Repair, Safety, Modern Education
measures.question: To provide safe, modern schools by upgrading/repairing aging classrooms, science labs, career technology and school facilities to support college/career readiness in math, science, technology, arts, engineering, and skilled trades; and fixing deteriorating roofs, plumbing, HVAC, and electrical systems; shall Escalon Unified School District's measure authorizing $26,000,000 in bonds at legal rates be adopted, levying approximately $18 per $100,000 assessed value ($1,700,000 annually) while bonds are outstanding, with independent audits, citizen oversight and all money locally controlled?

measures.title: Lincoln Unified School District Facilities and Safety Measure
measures.question: Lincoln Unified School District Facilities and Safety Measure. To improve the quality of education; make safety/security improvements; provide classrooms and labs for job training and career readiness; replace roofs and HVAC systems; restrooms and facilities improvements; shall Lincoln Unified School District's measure authorizing $79,000,000 of bonds be adopted at legal rates, estimated levies averaging $39.07 per $100,000 assessed value ($4,471,000 annually) while bonds are outstanding, with citizens' oversight, audits, no money for salaries and funding only for LUSD schools?
measures.notes: VIG pdf pp. 593-596. No argument notice posted on the ROV page for V (only Notice and Impartial Analysis).

measures.jurisdiction: Galt Joint Union High School District
measures.title: Galt Joint Union High School District, Repair/Safety and Vocational Training Measure
measures.question: Galt Joint Union High School District, Repair/Safety and Vocational Training Measure. To upgrade classrooms to maintain quality education/school safety by preparing students for skilled trades including welding/construction/plumbing; repairing leaky roofs; removing asbestos/mold; shall Galt Joint Union High School District's measure be adopted, authorizing $43,000,000 in bonds at legal rates, levying $30 per $100,000 of assessed valuation, generating $3,100,000 annually, while bonds are outstanding, prohibiting funds for administrators salaries/pensions, requiring independent citizens' oversight, audits, all funds locally controlled?
measures.notes: Sacramento County is the lead county; San Joaquin ROV links out to Sacramento County for details. Printed in the SJ VIG pdf pp. 588-592 (appears on only the ballot types for the SJ portion of the district).

voter_information_guide.note: Composite of all 131 ballot styles; each voter receives only their own ballot style. Candidate statements of qualifications are voluntary, printed as submitted. State VIG (statewide props) mailed separately: https://voterguide.sos.ca.gov/

gaps: Federal, statewide, State Assembly and judicial-retention candidates are NOT on the ROV "Local Candidate Roster" (local contests only). They were taken from the county's official sample ballots inside the County Voter Information Guide composite (ballot-style pages). Party preference is as printed there; no website/email/incumbent data exists for them in an official county list (all null). The SOS certified candidate list was not consulted.

The Local Candidate Roster is a snapshot printed 8/20/2026 (file candidate-roster-(35)). The later County VIG sample ballots agree with it on all 37 contested local contests (same candidates and designations; only line-wrap whitespace differs). No newer roster was found on the ROV page. The write-in roster is dated 10/6/2026 and may change before the Oct 20 write-in filing deadline.

No county offices (Board of Supervisors, Sheriff, District Attorney, Assessor, etc.) appear on the Nov 3 ballot: not in the Notice of Election, Offices Up For Election, or any of the 131 sample ballot styles. The Notice lists "Judge of the Superior Court - 7 seats (Subject to Elections Code 8203)" but no Superior Court contest appears on any sample ballot. No State Senate contest is on San Joaquin County ballots. No county-level runoffs exist.

75 roster contests are flagged "On Ballot: No" (candidates do not exceed seats; appointment in lieu of election). They are in appointed_in_lieu, not contests. 13 contests listed in the Notice of Election have no qualified candidate in the roster at all (see no_candidate_contests); outcome (appointment or vacancy) not published on the pages fetched.

Candidate Statements of Qualifications (pdf pp. 540-577 of the VIG composite) were not extracted; only page references (soq_vig_pdf_page) and the roster "statement filed" flags are recorded. Some statements mention campaign websites, but these are not from the official list and were not recorded.

Interactive lookup tools (Omniballot sample-ballot lookup, votinginfotool.org widget, ArcGIS maps, BallotTrax) were identified but not exercised; they need an address/voter identity. Instead a precinct-to-ballot-type crosswalk was derived from the ROV association list PDF (1,180 regular precincts -> 131 ballot types; see precinct_ballot_type.json and ballot_styles.json).
ROV FAQ page content loads dynamically and was not captured. The ROV home "Sample Ballot" quick link (/department/rov/voting/sample-ballot-options) returns HTTP 404.

Source conflicts: (a) drop boxes available "starting October 2" (ROV drop-box page) vs "October 5" (VIG, calendar); (b) ROV email registrar@sjgov.org (website) vs registration@sjgov.org and vbm@sjgov.org (VIG); (c) VIG table of contents page ranges are shifted relative to actual content (ballot styles pdf pp. 16-539, candidate statements pp. 540-577, measures pp. 578-596).

Voter's Choice Act status is inferred (San Joaquin absent from the SOS VCA county list; ROV materials describe assigned polling places and countywide "No Wrong Location" voting). The ROV pages fetched do not state VCA status explicitly. The SOS list page may not reflect counties that adopted VCA after 2022.

Measure G (Galt Joint Union High School District) is administered with Sacramento County as lead county; only the SJ portion of the district is on San Joaquin ballots (3 ballot types). Spanish and other-language documents (Spanish VIG, Notices, facsimile ballots) were not downloaded.

Incumbent flag is set only where the county list prints the ballot designation "Incumbent" or "Appointed Incumbent" (local contests). Statewide/federal/Assembly incumbency is not stated in the county list (null).
